that is, to review the recitation of the Mishnayos,
which they were accustomed to learn with a melody
so that they would not forget,
because they would learn them by heart,
"and one who learns without a melody";
"Learn the received teaching, and let it be like a song" —
for one who states a thing without its reason,
And this is the meaning of
"the moon was created only for girsa":
And this is from the fifteenth of Av on,
for of the time before it the Gemara said
"The night was created only for sleep";
such as the nights of the Tammuz season.
that the measure of sixty breaths
and from the fifteenth of Av on,
when the night is longer than six hours,
one must add from the night onto the day,
"The moon was created only for girsa."
And this is what is said in Eichah,
הַמְכוּוָּן עַל לִימּוּד תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
which refers to the study of Torah she'b'al peh;
for this will be the rectification in exile,
since the essence of exile is
in order to extract from there
And when they have extracted all of Torah she'b'al peh,
וְלֹא יִהְיֶה שָׂרִיד לְבֵית עֵשָׂו וְגוֹ׳
"And there shall be no survivor of the house of Esav," etc.
וְכֵן תָּמִיד יֶאֱרַע חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר בְּאָב
And so the fifteenth of Av always falls
in the days before or after
in which is said the passage "When you beget"
and after that the second Commandments;
as it says in the Midrash
"And in the second Tablets I give you
that there be in them halachos, Midrash and aggados."
And when it falls on that Shabbos itself,
it is certainly a time suited
for the spreading of Torah she'b'al peh;
as we said the meaning of
"Comfort, comfort My people, says your G-d"
that the entire purpose of the exiles
is only to extract from them
of the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh within them,
And this is what they said in the Mishnah:
"There were no festive days for Yisrael
כַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר בְּאָב וּכְיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים וְכוּלֵּי
like the fifteenth of Av and Yom HaKippurim," and so on;
שֶׁשְּׁנֵיהֶם מֵעִנְיַן בְּחִינַת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
for both pertain to the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh:
the day on which the second Tablets were given,
שֶׁכָּלוּל בָּהֶם גַּם תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
in which Torah she'b'al peh is also included;
and likewise the fifteenth of Av
is a time suited for adding
in Torah she'b'al peh, as mentioned above.
And it says, "And so it says:
'Go out and gaze, O daughters of Tziyon,
that is, upon the King to Whom peace belongs;
"upon the crown with which his mother crowned him" —
as Rashi, of blessed memory, explained.
And this is based on what it says
"A woman of valor is the crown of her husband";
and this is why the Gemara brings in connection with this
"In the future the Holy One, blessed is He,
will make a dance for the tzaddikim,
וְהוּא יוֹשֵׁב בֵּינֵיהֶם בְּגַן עֵדֶן וְכוּלֵּי
and He will sit among them in Gan Eden," and so on;
that is, they will be like a crown
for the Holy One, blessed is He.
And this is "the crown with which his mother crowned him,"
is the aspect of Knesses Yisrael.
And so the souls of Yisrael will surround,
as it says, "the crown of her husband";
and this is the secret of "a woman shall surround a man"
